hard_rules: wow-service invokes wow-cbm E6-A and never reimplements provider query normalization candidate explanation comparison or cache algorithms
raw credentials endpoints session handles provider cursors database paths and arbitrary tool names never cross public service or CLI surfaces
StableExternalGeneration ObservedMutableGeneration and OpaqueExternalState are never silently upgraded or refreshed mid-operation
every provider store selection or context effect registers OperationId plus CanonicalRequestDigest before dispatch
response loss never proves no effect and OutcomeUnknown blocks blind repeat until exact reconciliation
provider output always remains semantic_candidate Candidate with negative_authority unavailable
provider locators remain unverified until one exact project or reference owner mapping receipt
ExactMapped proves locator correspondence only and never validates provider prose relation rank score recommendation or absence
service never maps by name path snippet fuzzy rank provider exact label or hidden E4 search
selection is explicit and never top first last best highest score sole same name same path or same snippet
selection does not upgrade confidence or grant edit tool publication runtime platform or negative authority
context receives only exact mapped owner roots and provider prose rank score remain outside framework facts
provider failure is scoped optional degradation and never triggers hidden provider model cache search or snippet fallback
continuation and retry bind exact original provider external state query profiles identities and cumulative budgets
cache and retention never upgrade freshness authority or reproducibility
no public success before retention audit and mandatory reverse resource closure
applications depend on wow-service only and invoke one service operation per command
missing implementation adapter authorization reconciliation owner mapping provider benchmark fixture or checksum evidence is blocked or NotEvaluated never pass
no Cargo Rust source or CI during documentation phase

exact provider descriptor capability adapter credential authorization session external-state and reconciliation implementation profiles without committed secrets
exact E6-A bridge artifact catalog store durable operation retention audit project mapping reference mapping and context-use-case port IDs
query continuation result artifact mapping selection context cache privacy license security status error and canonicalization profiles
stable mutable opaque synthetic providers and one configured real-provider integration corpus
all response-loss cancellation substitution privacy credential mapping selection context and degradation vectors
all canonical requests receipts results mappings selections context handoffs envelopes CLI bytes exit-code and error vectors
accepted measured resource latency memory provider-call owner-call and output thresholds
all member and bundle SHA-256 values
